newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Delifrance hits high on Indonesian deal.
newsitem.headline: Delifrance hits high on Indonesian deal.

text.p: Delifrance Asia Ltd hit a new high of Singapore $1.87 in early dealings on Thursday on news that it had signed an Indonesian franchise deal.
At 0152 GMT, the stock had eased back to S$1.82, up 14 cents, with 584,000 units traded.
Delifrance's Indonesian partner PT Citra Bonang said the new joint venture would eventually have a turnover of some S$100 million a year.
Delifrance said the 50:50 joint ventue aims to open 120 Delifrance cafe bakeries in Indonesia by 2006.
An analyst with a British stockbroking firm said the deal looked lucrative for Delifrance and the share price "would have some way to go".
"We are looking at earnings growth of about 30 percent this year and next year should be slightly higher because of this deal," she said.
